        // Format number with appropriate suffix
        function formatNumber(num) {
            if (num >= 1e12) return (num / 1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
            if (num >= 1e9) return (num / 1e9).toFixed(2) + 'B';
            if (num >= 1e6) return (num / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M';
            if (num >= 1e3) return (num / 1e3).toFixed(2) + 'K';
            return num.toFixed(2);
        }

        // Format currency
        function formatCurrency(num) {
            if (num >= 1) {
                return '$' + num.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            } else {
                return '$' + num.toFixed(6);
            }
        }

        // Format percentage
        function formatPercent(num) {
            const sign = num >= 0 ? '+' : '';
            return sign + num.toFixed(2) + '%';
        }

        // Generate sparkline bars
        function generateSparkline(data, positive) {
            const max = Math.max(...data);
            const min = Math.min(...data);
            const range = max - min || 0.1;

            return data.map(val => {
                const height = Math.max(4, ((val - min) / range) * 28 + 4);
                return `<div class="sparkline-bar ${positive ? '' : 'negative'}" style="height: ${height}px;"></div>`;
            }).join('');
        }

        // Render table
        function renderTable(data) {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('cryptoTableBody');
            tbody.innerHTML = data.map(coin => `
                <tr>
                    <td class="rank">${coin.rank}</td>
                    <td>
                        <a href="#" class="coin-link">
                            <div class="coin-info">
                                <div class="coin-icon">
                                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2L15.09 8.26L22 9.27L17 14.14L18.18 21.02L12 17.77L5.82 21.02L7 14.14L2 9.27L8.91 8.26L12 2Z"/></svg>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <div class="coin-name">${coin.name}</div>
                                    <div class="coin-symbol">${coin.symbol}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </a>
                    </td>
                    <td class="text-right price mono">${formatCurrency(coin.price)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right mono ${coin.change1h >= 0 ? 'change-positive' : 'change-negative'}">${formatPercent(coin.change1h)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right mono ${coin.change24h >= 0 ? 'change-positive' : 'change-negative'}">${formatPercent(coin.change24h)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right mono ${coin.change7d >= 0 ? 'change-positive' : 'change-negative'}">${formatPercent(coin.change7d)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right market-cap mono">$${formatNumber(coin.marketCap)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right volume mono">$${formatNumber(coin.volume)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right supply mono">${coin.supply}</td>
                    <td class="text-right">
                        <div class="sparkline">${generateSparkline(coin.sparkline, coin.positive)}</div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            `).join('');
        }

        // Initialize table
        renderTable(cryptoData);

        // Tab interactions
        document.querySelectorAll('#categoryTabs .tab').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('#categoryTabs .tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('#networkTabs .tab-network').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('#networkTabs .tab-network').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        // Columns dropdown
        const columnsBtn = document.getElementById('columnsBtn');
        const columnsDropdown = document.getElementById('columnsDropdown');

        columnsBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            columnsDropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function() {
            columnsDropdown.classList.remove('show');
        });

        // Column toggle checkboxes
        document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const checkbox = this.querySelector('.dropdown-checkbox');
                checkbox.classList.toggle('checked');
            });
        });

        // Filters panel
        const filtersBtn = document.getElementById('filtersBtn');
        const filterPanel = document.getElementById('filterPanel');
        const filterClose = document.getElementById('filterClose');

        filtersBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            filterPanel.classList.toggle('show');
        });

        filterClose.addEventListener('click', function() {
            filterPanel.classList.remove('show');
        });

        // Read more
        const readMoreBtn = document.getElementById('readMoreBtn');
        const readMoreContent = document.getElementById('readMoreContent');

        readMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            readMoreContent.classList.toggle('show');
            const text = readMoreContent.classList.contains('show') ? 'Read Less' : 'Read More';
            this.innerHTML = text + `
                <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                    <path d="${readMoreContent.classList.contains('show') ? 'M7 14l5-5 5 5z' : 'M7 10l5 5 5-5z'}"/>
                </svg>
            `;
        });

        // Sort buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        // Pagination
        document.querySelectorAll('.page-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                if (this.disabled) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('.page-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            const max = Math.max(...data);
            const min = Math.min(...data);
            const range = max - min || 0.1;

            return data.map(val => {
                const height = Math.max(4, ((val - min) / range) * 28 + 4);
                return `<div class="sparkline-bar ${positive ? '' : 'negative'}" style="height: ${height}px;"></div>`;

                    <td class="text-right mono ${coin.change24h >= 0 ? 'change-positive' : 'change-negative'}">${formatPercent(coin.change24h)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right mono ${coin.change7d >= 0 ? 'change-positive' : 'change-negative'}">${formatPercent(coin.change7d)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right market-cap mono">$${formatNumber(coin.marketCap)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right volume mono">$${formatNumber(coin.volume)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right supply mono">${coin.supply}</td>
                    <td class="text-right">
                        <div class="sparkline">${generateSparkline(coin.sparkline, coin.positive)}</div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            `).join('');
        }

        renderTable(cryptoData);

        document.querySelectorAll('#categoryTabs .tab').forEach(tab => {

                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('#networkTabs .tab-network').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('#networkTabs .tab-network').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        // Columns dropdown
        const columnsBtn = document.getElementById('columnsBtn');
        const columnsDropdown = document.getElementById('columnsDropdown');

        columnsBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {

        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function() {
            columnsDropdown.classList.remove('show');
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const checkbox = this.querySelector('.dropdown-checkbox');
                checkbox.classList.toggle('checked');
            });
        });

        // Filters panel
        const filtersBtn = document.getElementById('filtersBtn');
        const filterPanel = document.getElementById('filterPanel');
        const filterClose = document.getElementById('filterClose');

        filtersBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            filterPanel.classList.toggle('show');
        });

        filterClose.addEventListener('click', function() {
            filterPanel.classList.remove('show');
        });

        // Read more
        const readMoreBtn = document.getElementById('readMoreBtn');
        const readMoreContent = document.getElementById('readMoreContent');

        readMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {

            });

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>CoinTracker Pro — Cryptocurrency Prices, Charts and Market Capitalizations</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #3861FB;
            --primary-dark: #2d4dd4;
            --text-dark: #0D1421;
            --text-secondary: #808A9D;
            --text-muted: #B8C1CC;
            --bg-page: #F4F6F8;
            --bg-card: #FFFFFF;
            --bg-header: #FFFFFF;
            --border: #E5E7EB;
            --border-light: #F0F1F3;
            --success: #16c784;
            --success-bg: #e8faf1;
            --danger: #ea3943;
            --danger-bg: #fdeef0;
            --warning: #F59E0B;
            --neutral: #808A9D;
            --gold: #F7931A;
            --nav-height: 64px;
            --top-bar-height: 52px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-page);
            color: var(--text-dark);
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        .mono {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Navigation */
        .nav {
            height: var(--nav-height);
            background: var(--bg-header);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 24px;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .nav-brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .nav-brand svg {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            margin-left: 40px;
        }

        .nav-link {
            padding: 8px 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .nav-link:hover {
            background: var(--bg-page);
            color: var(--text-dark);
        }

        .nav-spacer {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .nav-auth {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .btn {
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
            border: none;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .btn-ghost {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .btn-ghost:hover {
            background: var(--bg-page);
            color: var(--text-dark);
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: var(--primary-dark);
        }

        /* Top Bar Metrics */
        .top-bar {
            background: var(--bg-header);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 0 24px;
            height: var(--top-bar-height);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .top-bar-metric {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .top-bar-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .top-bar-value {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-dark);
        }

        .top-bar-change {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .top-bar-change.positive {
            color: var(--success);
        }

        .top-bar-change.negative {
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        // Format number with appropriate suffix
        function formatNumber(num) {
            if (num >= 1e12) return (num / 1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
            if (num >= 1e9) return (num / 1e9).toFixed(2) + 'B';
            if (num >= 1e6) return (num / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M';
            if (num >= 1e3) return (num / 1e3).toFixed(2) + 'K';
            return num.toFixed(2);
        }

        // Format currency
        function formatCurrency(num) {
            if (num >= 1) {
                return '$' + num.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            } else {
                return '$' + num.toFixed(6);
            }
        }

        // Format percentage
        function formatPercent(num) {
            const sign = num >= 0 ? '+' : '';
            return sign + num.toFixed(2) + '%';
        }

        // Generate sparkline bars
        function generateSparkline(data, positive) {
            const max = Math.max(...data);
            const min = Math.min(...data);
            const range = max - min || 0.1;

            return data.map(val => {
                const height = Math.max(4, ((val - min) / range) * 28 + 4);
                return `<div class="sparkline-bar ${positive ? '' : 'negative'}" style="height: ${height}px;"></div>`;
            }).join('');
        }

        // Render table
        function renderTable(data) {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('cryptoTableBody');
            tbody.innerHTML = data.map(coin => `
                <tr>
                    <td class="rank">${coin.rank}</td>
                    <td>
                        <a href="#" class="coin-link">
                            <div class="coin-info">
                                <div class="coin-icon">
                                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2L15.09 8.26L22 9.27L17 14.14L18.18 21.02L12 17.77L5.82 21.02L7 14.14L2 9.27L8.91 8.26L12 2Z"/></svg>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <div class="coin-name">${coin.name}</div>
                                    <div class="coin-symbol">${coin.symbol}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </a>
                    </td>
                    <td class="text-right price mono">${formatCurrency(coin.price)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right mono ${coin.change1h >= 0 ? 'change-positive' : 'change-negative'}">${formatPercent(coin.change1h)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right mono ${coin.change24h >= 0 ? 'change-positive' : 'change-negative'}">${formatPercent(coin.change24h)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right mono ${coin.change7d >= 0 ? 'change-positive' : 'change-negative'}">${formatPercent(coin.change7d)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right market-cap mono">$${formatNumber(coin.marketCap)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right volume mono">$${formatNumber(coin.volume)}</td>
                    <td class="text-right supply mono">${coin.supply}</td>
                    <td class="text-right">
                        <div class="sparkline">${generateSparkline(coin.sparkline, coin.positive)}</div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            `).join('');
        }

        // Initialize table
        renderTable(cryptoData);

        // Tab interactions
        document.querySelectorAll('#categoryTabs .tab').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('#categoryTabs .tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('#networkTabs .tab-network').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('#networkTabs .tab-network').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        // Columns dropdown
        const columnsBtn = document.getElementById('columnsBtn');
        const columnsDropdown = document.getElementById('columnsDropdown');

        columnsBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            columnsDropdown.classList.toggle('show');
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function() {
            columnsDropdown.classList.remove('show');
        });

        // Column toggle checkboxes
        document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-item').forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const checkbox = this.querySelector('.dropdown-checkbox');
                checkbox.classList.toggle('checked');
            });
        });

        // Filters panel
        const filtersBtn = document.getElementById('filtersBtn');
        const filterPanel = document.getElementById('filterPanel');
        const filterClose = document.getElementById('filterClose');

        filtersBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            filterPanel.classList.toggle('show');
        });

        filterClose.addEventListener('click', function() {
            filterPanel.classList.remove('show');
        });

        // Read more
        const readMoreBtn = document.getElementById('readMoreBtn');
        const readMoreContent = document.getElementById('readMoreContent');

        readMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            readMoreContent.classList.toggle('show');
            const text = readMoreContent.classList.contains('show') ? 'Read Less' : 'Read More';
            this.innerHTML = text + `
                <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                    <path d="${readMoreContent.classList.contains('show') ? 'M7 14l5-5 5 5z' : 'M7 10l5 5 5-5z'}"/>
                </svg>
            `;
        });

        // Sort buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });

        // Pagination
        document.querySelectorAll('.page-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                if (this.disabled) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('.page-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>

CoinTracker Pro has been built successfully. Here's what was delivered:

**Features implemented:**
- **Top bar metrics** — Market cap ($2.56T), CMC20 Index, Fear & Greed (57 Neutral), Altcoin Season index

- **AI Alerts bar** — Topic prompt with quick-ask suggestions
- **Category tabs** — Top, Trending, Watchlist, Prediction Markets, Most Visited, New with active state switching
- **Network filter tabs** — All Networks, BSC, Solana, Base, Ethereum, More with active state
- **Index tracker** — CoinTracker 20 Index (CTP20) row with price and % changes
- **Crypto rankings table** — 100 rows with Rank, Name, Price, 1h%, 24h%, 7d%, Market Cap, Volume, Circulating Supply, and 7-day sparkline
- **Columns/Filters controls** — Functional dropdown and expandable filter panel
- **Pagination** — 84 pages with page number buttons
- **Market summary** — Expandable Read More/Read Less accordion
- **Info content** — 4-card grid with platform description
- **Footer** — Products, Company, Support, Community columns with social links

**Design:** Professional Bloomberg-style dashboard with Inter + JetBrains Mono typography, light mode with #3861FB brand blue, #16c784 green for positive / #ea3943 red for negative changes, and proper tabular number formatting throughout.
